input.quote: Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
input.rationale: Assignment is blanket-prohibited for us with no affiliate or M&A carve-out and no reasonableness standard, and Article XX provides that any Change of Control automatically terminates the Agreement and all our licences absent Licensor's consent — both walk-away items. Article XXII compounds this with a Licensor right of first refusal over a sale of our business. We have added the affiliate/successor carve-out and removed the change-of-control termination; the ROFR should also come out.

input.quote: ARTICLE III OWNERSHIP Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein.
input.rationale: Licensor's ownership of its own platform is acceptable, but the Agreement says nothing about our trade, order and client data (which flows through the hosted Platform) and Article XXI only requires us to hand materials back to Licensor. Customization/front-end work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b) falls into Licensor-owned Licensed Technology with no perpetual licence back and an express bar on modification — short of even the fallback. We have added a Licensee Data ownership sentence and a perpetual, royalty-free licence to paid-for deliverables.
